title: High-Protein Crispy Air Fryer Tofu Bowls with Peanut Sauce
description: These high-protein crispy air fryer tofu bowls combine golden, protein-packed tofu and fresh edamame with a rich peanut sauce in just 25 minutes. Ideal for quick weeknight dinners or meal prep, this vegetarian dish delivers big flavor and satisfying macros. Save it for your next meal prep.
steps: Pat the pressed tofu dry with paper towels and cut into 3/4-inch cubes.
Place the tofu cubes in a medium bowl, toss with 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1/2 tablespoon of sesame oil, then sprinkle with cornstarch until evenly coated.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Add the coated tofu to the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 14 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until the tofu is golden brown and crispy on the edges.

While the tofu cooks, whisk together the peanut butter, remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, minced ginger, remaining 1/2 tablespoon sesame oil, and 3 to 4 tablespoons of warm water in a small bowl until smooth and pourable.
Steam or microwave the shelled edamame on high for 2 minutes until hot and tender.
Divide the warm brown rice among 4 bowls, then top each with the crispy air fryer tofu, warm edamame, and shredded purple cabbage.
Drizzle the peanut sauce generously over each bowl before serving.
tips: Press the tofu thoroughly with heavy objects or a tofu press for at least 15 minutes to remove excess moisture for crispier results.
Swap purple cabbage for shredded carrots or sliced cucumbers based on what you have in your fridge.
Store components separately if meal prepping to keep the cabbage crisp and prevent the tofu from getting soggy.
storage: Store leftover components in airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

video_script.hook: Make these crispy air fryer tofu bowls with 24 grams of protein!
steps_short: Press and cube your extra-firm tofu.
Toss the tofu in soy sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
Air fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 12 minutes until crispy.
Whisk together the creamy peanut sauce ingredients.
Assemble bowls with rice, tofu, edamame, cabbage, and peanut sauce.

issues: 1 tablespoon of cornstarch is insufficient to properly coat 16 oz of cubed tofu for a genuinely crispy air fryer crust; standard ratio is 1.5 to 2 tablespoons.
Peanut sauce lacks liquid to thin it out properly for drizzling; 2 tablespoons of water is insufficient for 1/4 cup peanut butter plus other thick ingredients.
Brown rice amount (2 cups cooked for 4 servings) provides only 1/2 cup per serving, which is very light for a bowl meal; 3 to 4 cups is standard.
